comments.body: We'd like to give an update about EOF, more specifically the ["Mega EOF"](https://notes.ethereum.org/ZOEv9yyHQdmxTVaYiJmy9Q) specification.

I'd like to discuss options around providing trust-minimized access to the consensus layer from inside the EVM.

I've written out the basic points here: https://notes.ethereum.org/@ralexstokes/notes-on-cl-access

If there's time I'd like to go over on the call as this pertains to how exactly we go about shipping something like EIP-4788 (in the mix for Cancun).

also: an administrative update on 4895 https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/6803

I would like to go over the following proposal if we have a time:
* https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/395
